First, 43 weeks and 6 days = (43 × 7) + 6 = 301 + 6 = 307 days.  
Start date: 1894-04-10.  
Add 307 days:  
April 10 → April 30 = 20 days (remain 287)  
May 31 days → 256 left  
June 30 → 226 left  
July 31 → 195 left  
August 31 → 164 left  
September 30 → 134 left  
October 31 → 103 left  
November 30 → 73 left  
December 31 → 42 left  
1895 January 31 → 11 left  
February 28 in 1895 (not leap year) → 11 days into March = March 12, 1895.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1895-03-12
